import bpy
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['harbor_craft']
c=bpy.data.collections['Harbor_Arrival_Landing']
c.hide_viewport=False;c.hide_render=False
states=[]
for o in c.objects:
 states.append((o,o.hide_get(),o.hide_render));o.hide_set(False);o.hide_render=False;o.select_set(True)
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for o in c.objects:o.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=next(o for o in c.objects if o.type=='MESH')
bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(ns['root']/'assets/harbor_landing_mcp.glb'),export_format='GLB',use_selection=True,
 export_texcoords=True,export_normals=True,export_tangents=True,export_vertex_color='NONE',
 export_materials='EXPORT',export_image_format='AUTO',export_apply=True,export_yup=True,export_animations=False)
for o,h,r in states:o.hide_set(h);o.hide_render=r
c.hide_viewport=True;c.hide_render=True
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('LANDING_REEXPORTED', (ns['root']/'assets/harbor_landing_mcp.glb').stat().st_size)
